headline: Dow swings from loss to profit as revenue rebounds
summary_short: Revenue was $12.09B, up 19.7% y/y and 23.5% q/q, as Dow swung to net income of $721M from an $835M loss a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue reached $12.09B, up 19.7% y/y and 23.5% q/q. Gross profit of $2.17B (implied gross margin ~17.9% vs ~5.8% y/y) lifted operating income to $1.39B from a $15M loss a year ago, EBIT to $1.08B from a $450M loss, and EBITDA to $1.75B, up 536.9% y/y. Net income swung to $721M from an $835M loss, and diluted EPS moved to $0.99 from a $1.18 loss per share. No cash-position or guidance figures are on the shard.
